# db-23 — DataBall appends must merge schemas by name with numeric widening

An append into an existing session merges schemas:
- columns are unioned by name, case-insensitively;
- a missing column is NULL;
- numeric types widen: an integer pair to the wider integer, and an integer with FLOAT or DOUBLE to DOUBLE.

The physical column is widened in place with `ALTER COLUMN … SET DATA TYPE`, for wide and layout sessions alike. Any other type conflict throws, naming the column, both types and both sources. db-11 reuses this rule for many-file opens.

**Findings:** db-11 split (owner, 2026-10-10) · **Size:** S · **Tree:** databall

**2026-10-11** — From db-22 relay (2026-10-11), pre-existing on 7c17c59: a wide CSV append of a unit-header file (Gain(dB)) into a session that already has Gain throws 'Duplicate canonical column' because the wide schema is applied after the merge. Merge by canonical name.

trust: unverified; by: Jon R

**Not in this slice:** opening many files (db-11); DATE/TIMESTAMP widening; changes to replace imports.

## Why

Split out of db-11 on 2026-10-10. Owner decisions: schema merge by default with numeric widening (suite alignment doc), and widening in layout sessions alters the owning physical column (db-11 spec interview, 2026-10-10).

From reviews:
- Layout physical types were fixed at first import, and appends were cast to them.
- db-08 added an in-place `ALTER … SET DATA TYPE` path for all-null columns (`InferredNullColumnType`). Reuse it.

**Model note (owner, 2026-10-10):** Claude-only relay. Implementer: **Haiku 5.5, high**, a trial on a small, well-scoped slice. The reviewer and architect models are set at relay start.
